input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: This hosting agreement contains no exit or transition provisions. Section 13 (p0078) only makes Client responsible for arranging a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days, and confirms Client retains ownership of its domains and Client Content; Section 14 (p0079) merely continues services until the end of the month following a termination notice. Section 10 (Confidentiality) imposes no return-or-destroy obligation, and no clause anywhere requires TrueLink to export or return Client data, to provide migration assistance, or to delete data on a defined timeline. The fallback (90 days of transition assistance plus data export within 30 days) therefore fails entirely, so we insert the preferred clause into the termination section: up to six months of assistance at then-current rates, return of Client data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion after return.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and data return obligation in Section 14
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no exit provisions, so on termination we would have no right to migration help or to get our data back. We have added our standard clause: up to six months of transition assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export if six months is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Client Content and other Client data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
